request: Extend Canopy with optional per-vertex underside elevations so a collider-free plaster finish can follow the measured sloped source soffit instead of floating as a horizontal sheet.
semantics: geometry.vertexY is an optional array of absolute underside heights aligned one-to-one with geometry.polygon vertices. It must define a planar surface (reject mismatched counts or non-planar values rather than silently flattening); the canopy underside follows those heights, thickness extrudes upward to the existing source face, and collider:false emits no colliders. With vertexY omitted, current horizontal Canopy behavior is unchanged. Canopy face triangulation must preserve shared polygon edges and the supplied vertex heights.
